command:
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap-start >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
modprobe zram num_devices=1
echo lzo > /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm
echo 512M > /sys/block/zram0/disksize
mkswap /dev/zram0
swapon -p 100 /dev/zram0
EOF
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap-stop >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
swapoff /dev/zram0 2>/dev/null || true
rmmod zram 2>/dev/null || true
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap-start /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap-stop
cat /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap-start

[Unit]
Description=Compressed in-memory swap (zram)
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=swap.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target
Before=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/zram-swap-start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/zram-swap-stop

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target swap.target
EOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable zram-swap.service
sudo -n systemctl start zram-swap.service
